title: smithable.context.yml
description: Implementation choices: the adapter, the database, conventions, packages, plugins and the AI policy. The only file that may name technologies.

adapter.description: The adapter that generates the app (tanstack).

database.description: The database the app stores its records in (sqlite).

conventions.description: Conventions custom code follows, one per line, for people and models writing it.

guidance.description: What a model writing custom code should know about this app.

plugins.description: The project's own plugins (smithable/plugins/<name>/), by name.

packages.description: Libraries for custom code: name to exact version.

plausible.description: Plausible: the app's domain as Plausible knows it, e.g. shop.example.com.

umami.description: Umami (its hosted service): the website id.

fathom.description: Fathom: the site id, eight capital letters or digits.

google.description: Google Analytics: the measurement id, e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX. Asks for consent first.

analytics.description: Counting visits with one provider and the app's id with it, in production builds only. Google needs the visitor's consent, so it turns on the consent bar; the others keep no cookies.

policy.description: local-only, eu-only, best-available (the default when nothing is said), or custom.

allow.description: With custom: the models allowed, by name.

ai.description: Where a model may run: the policy, and with custom the models allowed.
